title: Grateful Dead Live at Yale Bowl, Yale University on 1971-07-31
source: 2 Source Matrix by Dusborne;Soundboard (shnid:132730)SBD -> Master Reel -> CD,CD -> Samplitude Professional v10.02 -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> FLAC; Audience (shnid:101438)Sources:I: AudMR > CD > EAC > WAV > SHN,II: AudMR > C > DAT > CD > EAC > WAV > SHN,single AKG 190E mic > Uher 4000 Report-L 5" Reel deck, 1/2 track tapes on a Revox A-700 (tweaked the head azimuth to match the original recording).  Signal fed into DigiDesign Pro Tools on a Macintosh with Audio Media III sound card. The only post processing was normalization.

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording captures the band in top form with a smoking Dark Star, a tight Sugar Magnolia and an inspired China>Rider sequence.
ai_review.review: The matrix source is praised for its crystal‑clear, well‑balanced sound that lets the band's instrumental prowess shine. Reviewers highlight a dynamic performance featuring a standout Dark Star, an ultra‑tight Sugar Magnolia, and a compelling China>Rider jam, despite minor vocal shortcomings and the usual ’71 unevenness.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers rate the release 4‑5 stars, emphasizing both superb recording quality (matrix) and strong musical moments; minor performance unevenness keeps it just shy of perfect.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Matrix blend praised for clarity and balance; thorough mastering noted as making a big difference, with no reported drop‑outs or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers describe the set as dynamic and inspired, with tight transitions—especially on Sugar Magnolia—and varied jams that keep the momentum high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Instrumentally top‑form; guitar work highlighted as inspiring and dynamic.
